query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Azure Workload Identity CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # nightly
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release-**
    paths-ignore:
      - docs/**
      - README.md

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  azwi_build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # TODO(aramase): add windows test env
        env: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.env }}
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@eb238b55efaa70779f274895e782ed17c84f2895 # v2.6.1
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9bb56186c3b09b4f86b1c65136769dd318469633 # v4.1.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@0c52d547c9bc32b1aa3301fd7a9cb496313a4491 # v5.0.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27"
          check-latest: true
      - name: Build azwi
        run: |
          make bin/azwi
      - name: Validate azwi commands
        run: |
          ./bin/azwi version
          ./bin/azwi -h
          ./bin/azwi serviceaccount -h
          ./bin/azwi serviceaccount create -h
          ./bin/azwi serviceaccount delete -h
          ./bin/azwi jwks -h
